newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eurotunnel blaze may have been arson - source.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel blaze may have been arson - source.

text.p: A source close to a French investigation into a fire last November in the channel tunnel link operated by Eurotunnel said the blaze could have been arson.
"(It) seems that we can exclude the hypothesis that it was purely accidental," the source said.
Sources close to the British side of the investigation also said arson was now seen as the most likely cause.
The French state prosecutor leading the investigation will hold a news conference next week to report the preliminary findings of judicial experts, his office said.
Gerald Lesigne, prosecutor for Boulogne-sur-Mer, would not comment on a report by the British Broadcasting Corp (BBC) that the French inquiry suspected arson.
The fire damaged a large section of one of the tunnels and disrupted passenger and freight services in the tunnel link that the Anglo-French company operates between France and Britain.
It caused 200 million pounds ($328.2 million) in damage and sent eight truck drivers to hospital.
